title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Benefits: Elite-Night Reduction on Replacement Free Night Awards Holds
content:
This year's elite night credits lower the replacement's night price when a member applies a replacement among the Free Night Awards to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation. The elite-night reduction is the upper replacement night reduction when this year's elite night credits are at least the upper replacement night threshold, the lower replacement night reduction when they are at least the lower replacement night threshold, and nothing otherwise. It is taken off the replacement's night price once.

| This year's elite night credits | Elite-night reduction |
|---|---|
| 75 or more (upper replacement night threshold) | 3000 points (upper replacement night reduction) |
| 50 to 74 (lower replacement night threshold) | 1500 points (lower replacement night reduction) |
| Fewer than 50 | None |

This year's elite night credits are those accrued in the current calendar year, as the Ashbury Rewards membership record shows them. At 50 credits the reduction is 1500 points; at 75, 3000 points; at 49, none.
